data.exact_reserve_text:
The 2018 & prior years of account is closing by Reinsurance to close (RITC) after 36 months with a distributable profit of GBP 9,800,000 (2017 & prior years of account - collectable loss GBP 23,857,000).

The 2018 & prior years of account distributable profit of GBP 9,800,000 consists of:
 A profit of GBP 10,988,000 in respect of 2018 pure year of account.
 A loss of GBP  (1,393,000) in respect of 2017 & prior years of accounts movements in 2020.
 A net adjustment of GBP 205,000 in respect of unearned premium.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reports a net release on prior years of approximately GBP 17.9m in 2020, driven by favourable claims development across prior underwriting years (notably a profit on the 2018 year partially offset by adverse movement on 2017 & prior). The 2018 & prior block is closing by RITC with a distributable profit. COVID-19 had a limited quantified impact (GBP 3.5m provision) and reinsurance recoveries/support also contributed to the overall prior-year outcome.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2020 year of account has developed favourably to date with a Gross Earned Loss Ratio at 45.2% and the Syndicate has benefited from a benign year with minimal large loss activity.
Limited financial impact of Covid-19 claims (GBP 3.5m of Gross and Net provision).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure derived from the underwriting year attributable profit/(loss) breakdown (non-current-year components) rather than an explicit 'movement in prior years provision' gross column. A gross claims development triangle is present and consistent with reported movements. COVID-19 impact is explicitly quantified (GBP 3.5k) but overall PYD is taken from year-of-account result breakdown (gross vs net distinction: year-of-account allocation used as primary source per reporting guidance).
